description: Query live physical synthesis progress, geometric DRC completion telemetry, unlock state, and payment instructions for an existing job_id. Call this read-only polling tool after calligraphy_compile_board or human checkout to verify unlocked is true. Requires job_id; returns JSON status, unconnected_count, drc_errors, and payment instructions. Example: job_id='job_a1b2c3d4'.

job_id.description: Unique synthesis job identifier from calligraphy_compile_board or calligraphy_route_pcb.

name: calligraphy_get_job_status
title: Get PCB Synthesis Job Status
